thread:
ida (product): Announcement: introducing a "Protective Billing Buffer" for hosted API customers to reduce churn from immediate microburst overages. This is different from credits: it's a short-lived buffer applied automatically during policy transitions and major runtime kernel updates. Planned rollout: 2026-04-22 16:00 UTC.
sam (finance): Quick summary: how appears on invoice and accounting treatment?
nate (billing): The buffer will be visible as an invoice note and a single line item 'protective-billing-buffer' when consumed. We won't alter revenue recognition for buffer usage under $300/month/account; above that triggers manual review.
zoe (support): Need canned replies, opt-out for enterprise, and a triage flow. We'll need a list of customers with buffers applied.
rex (eng-ops): Impl note: buffer is assessed post-bill compute in the billing pipeline. No change to rate-limit headers. We'll add a small audit-only window first to validate detection rules.
ida (product): Policy highlights:
- Default buffer: $50/account/month (config per plan)
- Per-incident cap: $25
- Applied only for transient spikes identified within 15s windows and score <0.6 on anomaly model
- If buffer usage >60% in 7 days -> flag for account review
- Enterprise accounts can opt-out in Billing console
sam (finance): Operations: hold invoice for up to 36h if buffer adjustments cause >7% delta; auto-convert negative invoices to account credit; waive late fees related to adjustments.
nate (billing): Dashboard added: Billing -> ProtectiveBuffer shows applied events, flagged accounts, and held invoices. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/protective-buffer
rex (eng-ops): Rollout plan:
1) 16:00 UTC: enable audit-only in canary (eu-west-1-canary)
2) 16:30: enable buffer-apply in audit mode for 2h
3) 18:30: enable live @10% traffic, then gradual ramp if safe
Safety triggers: credit-apply-rate >0.7% of active accounts or payment-failure spike -> pause and rollback. Kill-switch exposed in control plane.
zoe (support): Draft customer note: "To reduce surprise overage charges during platform changes, we've introduced a Protective Billing Buffer that can absorb small, short-lived usage spikes. You can opt out in Billing Settings." Feedback?
sam (finance): Add guarantee: no double-billing; we will correct and notify within 48h for any errors. Also include contact for disputes.
ida (product): I'll upload canned replies and the support triage checklist to internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/protective-buffer by EOD. deploy-bot: scheduled: billing-buffer-service v1.0.0 -> eu-west-1-canary at 2026-04-22T16:00:00Z.
rex (eng-ops): We'll retain audit logs for 120 days and sample traces at 0.2% for debugging (PII scrubbed).
zoe (support): We'll staff 16:00-22:00 UTC for cutover. Please ping #support-alerts at each milestone.
ida (product): Thanks team  keep thresholds conservative and escalate any odd patterns to Finance + Eng-Ops.
